title: Story premise ENT082: The Placeholder King
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (creative-work struggles). Hook: The placeholder has taken over the project. Takeaway/theme: Make temporary decisions visibly temporary.
description: A designer wants to polish a title card but keeps treating a temporary gray rectangle as the final centerpiece. When the placeholder begins issuing absurd royal orders, the designer labels it TEMP, shrinks it to a corner, and finally draws the actual scene it was meant to support.
